purpose: Help support workers draft without delegating authority to send.
selection_criteria: Current-task fit; control over consequential action; failure recovery; effort and cost.
chosen_approach: Runtime model draft followed by human review.
alternatives: Fixed response templates; retrieval-only suggestions; manual drafting.
recorded_rationale: The plan states the boundary but does not retain the original selection rationale.
foreseeable_impacts: Misleading output may be accepted; latency and review effort may exceed the saved drafting time.
deepening_rationale: The draft choice depends on a user-data dependency authority boundary and an untested human-review assumption.
next_coherent_slice: Walk one draft through dependency outage human review correction and a recorded final disposition before implementation.
followup: Record choice criteria; compare alternatives; specify failure behavior; assign a validation plan.
